headline: 229 g/t AU IN 67Z STEP-OUT — Ashley Cuts 3.333 g/t Over 60m Bordering NexGold Goliath Complex, Dryden, Ontario
snippet: Ashley Gold Corp (CSE: ASHL) announced a drilling discovery today from the eastern step-out of the 67Z Zone at its Tak Patents in Dryden, Ontario, cutting 3.333 g/t Au over 60.00m from 24.00m downhole — including a 229 g/t Au sub-interval over 0.65m at 63.15m. The Tak Patents abut the NexGold Goliath-Gold Complex, one of the largest undeveloped gold deposits in Canada, making this a potentially district-defining land-package result; previous Phase II holes in this corridor returned intervals in the sub-gram range, making today's 3.333 g/t composite over 60m a material step-change in the project's exploration story.

headline: CRIMINAL MINE PROBE CLOUDS COZAMIN SALE — Zacatecas AG Demands 14 Categories of Mine Records; Fraud Probe Escalates as Capstone Sells to Luca for $290M
snippet: The Public Prosecutor's Office of Zacatecas formally served the legal representative of Capstone Copper's (TSX: CS) Cozamin mine today — September 25, 2026 — with a criminal document demand covering 14 categories of underground mine records, including maps, 3D block models, metallurgical balances, grade reconciliations and payment histories, investigating fraud and potential unauthorised mining outside concession limits. The demand arrives four days after Capstone announced the sale of Cozamin to Luca Mining Corp for US$290 million upfront plus up to US$95 million in contingent payments — a transaction that remains subject to closing conditions and could be materially complicated by the criminal inquiry's outcome.

headline: AETERNUM SEIZES 100% OF NKAMOUNA — Cameroon Co-Ni-Mn Project Changes From 51% JV to Full Ownership in All-Share Deal
snippet: Aeternum Resources (PINL: AETN) announced today it has upgraded its position in the Nkamouna Cobalt-Nickel-Manganese Project in Cameroon from a 51% earn-in option to full 100% ownership of American Renaissance Minerals LLC, the project sponsor. The all-share deal — up to 133.3 million shares issued against project milestones — is subject to closing conditions in Q4 2026; the Nkamouna deposit hosts a pre-existing NI 43-101 resource and requires a new mining permit from the Government of Cameroon, free of prior encumbrance. The transaction consolidates control of a cobalt-manganese resource at a time when ex-China supply chains for EV battery cathode materials remain a strategic priority for Western buyers.

headline: ANALYSTS: EXPLOSIVE NEW PHASE FOR GOLD MINERS — $4,300 Price, Supply Bottlenecks, Record Investment Demand Converge
snippet: Analysis published September 24 argues that the combination of gold holding above US$4,300 per ounce — despite a 23% correction from January's US$5,589 record — constrained new mine supply that takes years to permit and build, and a structural acceleration in central bank and institutional investment demand is setting up the gold mining industry for a rare compounding cycle: sustained high prices into a thin project pipeline. The World Gold Council expects investment demand to remain the primary demand driver through year-end 2026; Fortune Business Insights puts the global gold-mining market at US$327.8 billion in 2026, projecting nearly US$766 billion by 2034 at 11.2% CAGR.

headline: AGNICO $3,020/oz, BARRICK $2,550/oz IN Q2 — Record Miner Margins Build the Re-Rating Case as Gold Consolidates Above $4,300
snippet: With gold holding above US$4,300 per ounce while off January's US$5,589 peak, the latest analysis shows major gold miners are generating the widest per-ounce operating margins in the industry's recorded history: Agnico Eagle realised US$4,483/oz at an AISC of US$1,459 — a US$3,020 margin — reporting record quarterly free cash flow in Q2 2026; Newmont realised US$4,414 at an AISC of US$1,621 (US$2,800 margin); Barrick realised US$4,417 at US$1,866 (US$2,550 margin, returning US$1.5 billion to shareholders). The sector is generating cash at a rate the share prices have not yet fully priced in, making the re-rating case for both seniors and well-capitalised juniors increasingly compelling.

headline: 479 g/t AgEq OVER 1m TRUE WIDTH — Titiminas Hits High-Grade at Madre Sierra Norte; 12-Hole Program Paves Way for Peru MRE
snippet: Titiminas Silver (TSXV: TITI) released September 24 results from twelve additional packsack drill holes at the Madre Sierra Norte and Madre Sierra areas of its past-producing silver mine in Peru, with mineralized structures intersected in every hole — headlined by 201.2 g/t Ag, 1.70 g/t Au, 2.36% Cu = 479 g/t AgEq over 1.00m true width, and a second intercept of 107.8 g/t Ag, 5.32 g/t Au = 578 g/t AgEq over 0.65m TW. Results from this phase of drilling, combined with the ongoing HQ diamond drill program, will feed the maiden NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate targeted for end-Q2 / early Q3 2027 across Madre Sierra, Madre Sierra Norte and the Titiminas CRD deposit.

headline: 225.6m AT 1.33 g/t AU + 39.2 g/t AG IN NEVADA — i-80 Gold Step-Out Extends Mineral Point; One of Nevada's Largest Undeveloped Bulk-Mineable Resources Grows
snippet: i-80 Gold Corp (TSX: IAU) published initial results from its 2026/2027 Mineral Point drilling program in Ruby Hill, Nevada, with step-out hole iMP26-07 returning 1.33 g/t Au and 39.2 g/t Ag over 225.6 metres — extending the footprint of a project that already hosts the largest gold and silver mineral resource in i-80's portfolio and ranks among the largest undeveloped bulk-mineable oxide resources in Nevada. The 130,000-metre campaign uses up to seven rigs with approximately 30,000 metres completed through August; results feed a pre-feasibility study targeted for mid-2027 at projected 2026/2027 exploration spend of US$40–45 million.

headline: 232 g/t SILVER OVER 24m — Kootenay Hits Lupe Vein at Columba; 250 g/t Ag Over 11m Adjacent; Mexico 60,000m Program Running
snippet: Kootenay Silver Inc (TSXV: KTN) released expansion drill results from the Lupe Vein at its Columba High-Grade Silver Project in Chihuahua, Mexico, returning 232 g/t Ag over 24 metres and 250 g/t Ag over 11 metres in separate holes, with the Lupe system remaining open along strike and at depth after the program has now outlined mineralisation over roughly 520 metres of strike and 450 metres of vertical extent. The company has completed more than 30,000 metres of its staged 60,000-metre program, with results from 51 holes reported; additional drill holes in the B2, D and G vein systems returned sub-intervals to 2,010 g/t Ag, 0.7% Pb, 3.1% Zn.

headline: ALBEMARLE -4.6%, LIT ETF -1.09% — Lithium Equities Punished Friday on Battery Demand Anxiety; CATL Largest Mine Off-Line Ignored
snippet: Lithium proxies sold off sharply on September 25 with Albemarle (ALB) dropping 4.60% to US$108.25, SQM falling 2.84% to US$67.12 and the LIT ETF sliding 1.09% to US$68.82, driven by battery demand anxiety and a macro session dominated by gold and hawkish Fed commentary. The move came despite the fact that CATL's Jianxiawo mine — China's largest lithium producer by capacity — remains on care and maintenance following revocation of its environmental permit, a supply reduction of approximately 30,500 tonnes LCE that the market is effectively ignoring; global battery demand cleared 1.5 TWh annually for the first time in 2025 and is growing.

headline: 4.77 g/t AU SURFACE SAMPLE AT BONANZA RIDGE — New Age Metals Identifies New Structure 20m North of Blue Star Showing, Kenora, Ontario
snippet: New Age Metals (TSXV: NAM) reported today that its 2026 prospecting program at the Bonanza Ridge Gold and Critical Metals Project in the Kenora Mining District, northwestern Ontario, returned gold values up to 4.77 g/t Au, 4.68 g/t Au and 1.05 g/t Au from grab samples of a sub-parallel structure identified approximately 20 metres north of the historic Blue Star showing. The first batch of 215 grab samples has been returned from Activation Laboratories in Thunder Bay; results for the remaining 116 samples are pending. A high-resolution airborne geophysical survey and mechanized stripping at the Triggs occurrence were also completed as part of the 2026 program.
